where: The Bell Cellar (the flooded cellars and the drowned belfry pit under Lowtinder's lamp-house, where the old town bell lies in black water; a rope climbs the old shaft to Tinderwick's well)
mood: A flooded stone cellar under the sea: dripping water, black still pools, and somewhere a huge old bell humming when the tide turns. Hushed, patient and a little sad, never horror.
